hearing.quote: Stabilization is a race against displacement—month-eleven keeps us ahead.
hearing.actionAsked: Approved month-eleven disbursement of $400K for West Oakland Stabilization Fund, maintaining the 23-day processing standard.

hearing.quote: When local commercial corridors maintain low crime and steady street trade, City Hall's primary responsibility is delivering reliable municipal fundamentals.
hearing.actionAsked: Prioritize seamless baseline infrastructure and municipal service delivery along Piedmont Avenue

hearing.quote: A stabilization fund only works if the procedural plumbing is sound—we are locking in transparent disbursement milestones to ensure Grand Lake merchants receive real, auditable relief.
hearing.actionAsked: Vote YES to advance the $2.5 million Commercial Stabilization for Grand Lake ordinance with mandatory disbursement milestones and audit protocols.

hearing.quote: We have moved past the point of emergency response; it is time to build a sustainable future for Ivy Hill.
Uptown's quieting streets aren't a mystery — they're a message. We can't let downtown get the hearing while Uptown gets the silence.
hearing.actionAsked: Add a dedicated Uptown commercial stabilization track to the Economic Development Committee docket within the next two cycles

hearing.quote: A multi-million-dollar downtown revitalization fund cannot be an open checkbook without verifiable benchmarks and audit triggers attached.
hearing.actionAsked: Demand line-item benchmarks and verified ROI metrics at the Economic Development Committee hearing before authorizing downtown disbursements.

hearing.quote: We don't need another report that sits on a shelf — we need dispatch data that tells the truth about who gets help and who gets ignored.
hearing.actionAsked: Filed the District 5 dispatch performance audit for the Alternative Response Initiative, verifying response metrics and pushing for continued expansion into East Oakland.

hearing.quote: The data in the soil test verification provides the evidence-based assurance I require to move this forward.
OARI's promise is that the right responder shows up — the report has to prove that promise works on Fruitvale's streets, not just in the city's spreadsheets.
hearing.actionAsked: I am voting to accept the OARI quarterly outcome report but adding a community-comment condition: numbers must break down response times and diversion rates by district, not just citywide, and I want a public briefing in D3 before any further expansion.

gavel.quote: Month-eleven, 23-day standard maintained — this fund delivers because Brenda Okoro's team treats every application like family.
